items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: How did you like playing with Kenny Clarke at that time?

ctx.x: No problem whatsoever. Well, I'm very thankful that I had a very good ear, you know. I could hear what was happening. So that saved me, you know.
How did you like playing with Kenny Clarke at that time? Because he was playing a very unusual drum style, wasn't he?

It was a good sound, yeah, and he -- of course, at times, he played off tempos and what have you quite a bit. But I didn't -- that didn't bother me. I became used to that. Quite a few drummers, they were used to playing off-beat and what have you.
